description: This source file contains functional test cases written in Python, primarily using pytest framework, to validate rbus data set/get handlers for various device parameters, and ensure bootstrap files are created and parameters are persisted correctly.

methods.name: test_DeviceInfo_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests setting and getting 'Device.DeviceInfo.X_RDKCENTRAL-COM_RFC.Feature.Telemetry.Version' via rbus

methods.name: test_DeviceTime_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests setting and retrieving DHCPv6 enable status and NTP server IP via rbus

methods.name: test_RFC_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests multiple RFC feature parameters related to HDMI version, speed limit, firmware, and CDL enable

methods.name: test_NonRFC_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests non-RFC device info parameters such as IP remote support and SSH enable

methods.name: test_Bootstrap_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests setting bootstrap-related parameters: partner product name, ESN prefix, partner name, SSR URL

methods.name: test_Bootstrap_File_Creation()
methods.description: Verifies bootstrap files exist after test, sets a bootstrap parameter, and confirms persistence to configuration files
